name: samarth-dbt
description: SAMARTH - Web-Based Human-in-the-Loop DBT System (PCR & PoA Acts)

scripts.setup: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
